evidence_timeline.summary: We present followup observations of the fast evolving, blue and luminous transient SN 2026wpd. The light curve shows a rapid rise to an absolute magnitude of ~ -19 in ~6 days. The LT spectrum displays prominent C III 5696 emission, similar to the transitional Ibn/Icn event SN 2023xgo. The transient is still rising and remains blue, with a hot photospheric temperature. Followup observations are encouraged.

publication_revisions.abstract: We present followup observations of the fast evolving, blue and luminous transient SN 2026wpd. The light curve shows a rapid rise to an absolute magnitude of ~ -19 in ~6 days. The LT spectrum displays prominent C III 5696 emission, similar to the transitional Ibn/Icn event SN 2023xgo. The transient is still rising and remains blue, with a hot photospheric temperature. Followup observations are encouraged.

publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26jiy (AT2026wpd) in galaxy CGCG 537-004 at magnitude m_o = 18.26 +/- 0.16. At a distance of 100 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61253.50 (2026-08-01.50) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.9 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 61251.60. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
